description: Defines the ChallengeOperation class which manages user-submitted challenge values, callbacks, and their validation states within a challenge system.

classes.name: ChallengeOperation
classes.description: Manages challenge values, validation, and callback triggers for challenge completion and cancellation.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Clears references to facilitate garbage collection.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Marks the challenge as complete and triggers the onComplete callback.

methods.name: nonvalidatedSubmit
methods.description: Submits non-validated challenge responses and resets nonvalidatedValues.

methods.name: isFinished
methods.description: Checks if all valid responses have been received.

methods.name: addNonvalidatedValue
methods.description: Adds a non-validated value and submits if all prompts are addressed.

methods.name: setValueStatus
methods.description: Sets validation status for a value, updates artifacts, and triggers callbacks or completes the challenge.
